messages:
emma: quick design sync — proposing compact token pill on the right for streaming. mock: https://img.redwood.dev/tmp/pill-stream (mock)
lucas: pill is actionable. can collapse to a 1.2k style count and expand to exacts on focus/click.
priya: accessibility: must expand on keyboard focus too, not hover-only. aria-live polite for debounced updates. contrast needs checking (4.5:1).
kelly: stop/regenerate: keep stop as primary during stream, show regenerate once finished. on small screens put regenerate in overflow menu. keyboard: Esc stops, Cmd/Ctrl+R regenerates.
emma: token pill should show cache badge (⚡) when prefix cache used — tooltip "cache: 42%". compact shows rounded count; expanded shows exact tokens and breakdown.
lucas: debounce UI updates to 350ms to avoid screen reader spam and layout jank.
priya: motion: respect prefers-reduced-motion and avoid long fades. shimmer only first 250-300ms.
kelly: prompt library rename suggestion: "Saved prompts" instead of "My prompts". change empty state copy to "Save prompts here for reuse in your workspace."
a11y-bot: reminder — file an a11y ticket for contrast, keyboard focus, and screen reader test cases.
emma: i'll assemble a 1-pager and updated comps by EOD. thanks!
